breadcrumbs.name: RFID Blood Bag Tags — Eliminate Transfusion Errors & Automate Blood Bank Inventory

summary: RFID blood bag tags provide automated, error-free identification of blood products from collection through testing, storage and transfusion — reducing the risk of ABO-incompatible transfusions, the leading cause of fatal transfusion reactions. HF RFID tags survive cold storage (-30 °C) and can be read through insulated transport containers.
